entries.notes: All six parameterized TypeScript declarations are translated as 27 executable Rust tests: three explicit starts, nine concurrent probes, one aggregate all-region pass, one in-progress cross-region stream, nineteen implicit starts, and two non-default-region hook round trips. Coverage preserves the complete 19-region set, strict run-ID tag/data-placement ownership, the documented execution-adjacency allowlist, unique concurrent run identity, stream visibility before completion, implicit VERCEL_REGION minting, opaque-token hook lookup, ordered sequential resume payloads, and terminal server state. Security-relevant cases require concurrent starts and opaque hook tokens to never cross-wire tenant run state, require readers to observe backend stream metadata rather than stale region-local state, and allow geographic execution elasticity without weakening exact tag ownership. Final GREEN must exercise real Rust run-ID tagging, queue routing, storage, stream, and hook-resume implementations; fixture-generated observations are insufficient.
